schemeContent.briefDescription: “Medical Assistance for Incurable Diseases” under the “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” by the Labour Resources Dept., provides financial assistance ranging from ₹7,500/- to ₹30,000/- to workers or craftsmen suffering from incurable diseases.

children.text: The “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” launched by the Labour Resources Department, Bihar, aims to provide social security through various types of financial assistance to workers and artisans in the unorganized sector.
